articles.author: The Associated Press
articles.title: BRICS leaders meet in India as wars and US tensions test the bloc - NPR
articles.description: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi hosts Russian President Vladimir Putin, Chinese President Xi Jinping and other leaders of the BRICS nations for a summit on trade, investment, and global conflicts.
articles.content: Leaders of the BRICS nations are meeting in New Delhi on Saturday for a summit focused on trade, investment and global conflicts, as the bloc seeks a bigger role in shaping the global agenda for emer… [+4020 chars]
